required_revisions: Implement a verified protected-component execution backend that enforces the isolation profile's read and write allowlists and network/subprocess denial before handler execution.
Publish the component source as a verified immutable project artifact and statically bind its handler only after project-scoped experimental registration.
Reconcile pandas and all runtime dependencies with the approved project environment.
Enforce the declared resource envelope and add containment regression tests.
rationale: The revision removes the arbitrary train_path configuration escape: the handler now requires the declared train_panel_csv input. The approved containment-boundary change has not yet been implemented. Existing component execution remains in-process and declarative only, so it cannot substantiate read confinement or network/subprocess denial for protected benchmark execution. No challenge run is authorized.
